name: prro-mcp
description: Read-only access to PRRO.cloud cash registers, shifts, fiscal tasks, billing and webhooks.
long_description: MCP server for the PRRO.cloud fiscalization API (Ukrainian software cash registers, PRRO). Lets the assistant see the real state of your cash registers, shifts, fiscal tasks, billing and webhook deliveries to help write and debug an integration. Read-only: it never issues receipts, opens or closes shifts, or changes settings.

prro_token.title: PRRO.cloud API token
prro_token.description: Machine API token issued in the PRRO.cloud cabinet. Use a separate token limited to the cash registers the assistant should see.

base_url.title: API base URL
base_url.description: Change only for a local or staging API.

tools.name: get_version
tools.description: PRRO.cloud API service, contract and server versions.

tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Client, scopes and cash registers of the token.

tools.name: get_dps_status
tools.description: Online/offline mode of work with the DPS.

tools.name: list_cash_registers
tools.description: Cash registers the token can reach.

tools.name: get_cash_register_state
tools.description: Shift, totals, cash balance and offline session of a cash register.

tools.name: get_task
